shape.comment: How many plain paragraphs may run together before a list, a table or a diagram is wanted. Mechanical, and always on.

judge.comment: The rules no pattern holds. A model answers one label per span. Switch this off where it costs more than it earns.

rules.name: Actionable
rules.ask: Does this text tell the reader something they can act on, or does it explain where something came from, what once happened, or how many of something there were?
rules.instead: Write what the reader does next. Put the background in spec/rationales.
